title: Live updates with server sent events
when: A page must update live from the server (progress, logs, notifications, a feed) and data only flows from server to client.
prompt:
Goal: A node:http event stream plus an EventSource client that reconnect on their own and never leak connections.
Steps:
1. Route /events: writeHead(200, { "content-type": "text/event-stream", "cache-control": "no-cache", connection: "keep-alive" }) and write ": ok" plus a blank line.
2. Keep clients in a Set; on req "close" delete the client and clear its timers; above 100 clients answer 503. Other paths get 404.
3. Frame each message as id:, event: and data: lines ending with a blank line; split multi line data into several data: lines.
4. Heartbeat comment every 25 s; replay events after Last-Event-ID from a ring buffer of 100.
5. Client: new EventSource("/events"), addEventListener per event name with JSON.parse(e.data) in try; show "Reconnecting" on error (reconnect is automatic, tune with retry:).
Quality bar:
- Closing the tab frees the server side client.
- No duplicate events after a reconnect.
- Connection state is announced in an aria-live region.
Pitfalls:
- Missing the blank line that ends each event.
- Compression or buffering that holds events back.
- Using the stream for client to server messages; use POST for those.
Verify:
- [ ] content-type is text/event-stream.
- [ ] Clients are removed on close.
- [ ] Heartbeat timer is cleared.
- [ ] Client parsing is in try.
Output: server.mjs with /events and broadcast(event, data); public/live.js with the client.

examples.input: show build progress live in the page
examples.output: /events stream with progress and done events, EventSource client updating a progress bar
